findings.evidence: code/EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean:292 `noncomputable def pTransverse (g : Bilin V) (K : DisKinematics V) : V := K.p - (g K.p K.q / g K.q K.q) • K.q`; :148 `noncomputable def reflect (g : Bilin V) (u : V) : V →ₗ[ℝ] V where toFun := fun v => v - (2 * (g u u)⁻¹ * g u v) • u`; PR `spatial_apply : F.spatial p = p - (g p F.n / g F.n F.n) • F.n`.
findings.fix: Add a Bilin-level projection next to Bilin.reflect, e.g. `def projOrthogonal (g : Bilin V) (u : V) : V →ₗ[ℝ] V := Module.preReflection u ((g u u)⁻¹ • g.flip u)` with `projOrthogonal_apply` and the g u u ≠ 0 orthogonality/kernel/range lemmas; set `Frame.spatial F := Bilin.projOrthogonal g F.n` and make `pTransverse g K = Bilin.projOrthogonal g K.q K.p` (rfl), so `pTransverse_orthogonal_q` becomes an instance of the generic orthogonality lemma.
findings.issue: Frame.spatial (p ↦ p - (g p n / g n n) • n) is the same projection as Hadronic.pTransverse g K = K.p - (g K.p K.q / g K.q K.q) • K.q and the same construction shape as Bilin.reflect in the file this PR already imports; three parallel definitions of one map.

summary: The frame theory is new relative to Mathlib (preReflection has no f x = 1 projection lemmas), but it adds a third hand-rolled copy of the 'shift along u by g·u / g u u' map already present in the imported DIS file, and one proof re-derives an expansion lemma that file already provides. Physlib is absent from the checkout, so the claim about Lorentz.Vector.spatialPart could not be verified.
